integrity: The mathematical argument is supported by explicit finite difference identities, an effective locality reduction and a refined partition asymptotic; independent scientific validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to uniformly sampled isomorphism classes of finite bijections in the one-successor relational signature; does not cover labelled measures or monadic second-order logic. Older 1997 general limit-law full texts were not inspected, leaving historical-priority uncertainty. Finite checker is not an infinite proof.
title: Integer-quantized first corrections to the unlabelled-permutation first-order zero-one law
